This adds support to libbpf for setting map pinning information as part of
the BTF map declaration
column2: to get automatic map pinning (and reuse) on load.

column1: The pinning type currently only supports a single PIN_BY_NAME mode
each map will be pinned by its name in a path that can be overridden
defaults to /sys/fs/bpf.
Since auto-pinning only does something if any maps actually have a
'pinning' BTF attribute set
column2: we default the new option to enabled

column1: assumption that seamless pinning is what most callers want.
When a map has a pin_path set at load time
pinned at that location (if any)
that map instead of creating a new one. If no existing map is found
newly created map will instead be pinned at the location.
Programs wanting to customise the pinning can override the pinning paths
using bpf_map__set_pin_path() before calling bpf_object__load() (including
setting it to NULL to disable pinning of a particular map).
